import sys

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    parts = line.split()
    n = int(parts[0])
    if n == 0:
        break
    prices = list(map(int, parts[1:n+1]))
    
    coins = 0
    expense = 0
    for p in prices:
        if p <= 500:
            coins += 1
            expense += p
    
    print(coins, expense)
